profile.headline: Technologist / Cloud Architect / Technical Lead / Full-Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Cloud Architect / Full-Stack Software Engineer / Technologist

Key Strengths
* Designed and implemented multi tenant SaaS application.
* Experience in all stages of software development, including design, development, QA and DevOps.
* Solid leadership skills, proven by leading both technical and non-technical teams

Specialties: .NET, C#, SQL, MongoDb, Microsoft Azure, Web Api, REST, TypeScript & Node

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Lead for FinTech SaaS https://www.connectbooster.com/
I led, designed, and developed a born-in-the-cloud multi-tenant SaaS platform, which is now the top MSP payment financial solution. I created and built ConnectBooster as a PaaS solution to take full advantage of Microsoft Azure's exceptional abilities. ConnectBooster serves thousands of customers a day 24/7, processing billions of dollars.

• Provide architectural leadership for multi-tenant SaaS platform deployed on Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Azure DevOps, and Mongo DB)
• Technical leadership and mentorship

Key Technologies
C#, MongoDB, Azure PaaS, SQL Server, Azure DevOps, Angular, REST APIs & GraphQL

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
I was a software developer for the Microsoft Business Solutions division, created CMS, portals, and tools that supported the MBS community. I lead a SharePoint Identity/Authentication integration project, url shortener for delivering centrally located localized content along with several secondary products and features.

Key Technologies
C#, ASP.NET, SQL Server, Azure, SharePoint, DurandalJS, KnockoutJS & jQuery

positions.title: Technology Evangelist -- Microsoft/APAC
positions.description:
Trusted Technical Advisor to Microsoft's up-and-coming ISV partners. I worked with a portfolio of approximately 70+ Microsoft ISV partners. I was responsible for working with Microsoft ISV partners at the CxO level to discuss and demonstrate and adopt the Microsoft platform solutions. I was also responsible for leading a team of Partner Account Manages to help partners grow their business and relationship with Microsoft. Topics would include Azure, SharePoint, SQL Server, Silverlight, Windows Phone & Win 7

Key Technologies
Azure, SQL Server, Windows Phone & Win 7

positions.title: Sr. Software Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for integration, load, and performance testing of Echelon's flagship product for providing Smart Grid IoT technology. I was responsible for ensuring the product would meet scale and performance requirements. I would create procedures and tools to simulate millions of IoT devices that would generate billions of data points.  I would then present those findings and also make recommendations for where/what to improve.

Key Technologies
C#, ASP.NET, SQL Server

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
I was in a contractor that converted into a Full-Time position. I was a software developer for the Microsoft Business Solutions division, created BizTalk solution to synchronize data, DevOps source code control branching/merging, build/release management along with several secondary products and features.

Key Technologies
C#, ASP.NET & SQL Server

positions.title: Software Development Engineer – Build Engineer
positions.description:
DevOps contractor  for Microsoft IT. I was responsible for sourcecode control branching/merging using Source Depot, build/release management, and SOX compliance. I created several tools for build management that were in use for 15 years.

Key Technologies
C#, ASP.NET & SQL Server

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Software development for a Content Management system, Bonds Management, and Teller Customer Portal. Along with numerous secondary products and features.

Key Technologies
C#, ASP.NET & SQL Server

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: I Developed several modules for farm property insurance.
